experiment.conclusion: The frozen executable-capture measurement on 1261 signal-defined Nasdaq-listed common stocks is -108.89 bps pooled (CI [-169.84, -64.04]), against a structural cost floor C0 of 1.02 bps and a break-even residual C* of -109.92 bps. The frozen clause order delivers INDETERMINATE because the preregistered entry-book reconstruction gate is not satisfied (the exchange published no near/far price band in any analysed 15:55 read, and the evaluable diagnostic agrees with the exchange reference price only 41.5% of the time) and because the signal-defined population is 52.2% of the universe. The rule's own verdict on the analysed sample is KILL_MATERIALITY: the measured capture is negative by two orders of magnitude relative to C0. The measurement is a LOWER bound on the true capture, and the missing pre-window liquidity that bounds it inflates the measured entry spread, so the negative figure is not robust enough to be recorded as a defensible kill without the operator accepting that residual.

new_evidence.claim: On the admitted 2026-06-12 Nasdaq closing session, the frozen executable-capture measurement of the late-NOII imbalance-change signal is -108.89 bps pooled (equal-share bundle, 1261 signal-defined Nasdaq-listed common stocks, symbol-clustered 95% CI [-169.84, -64.04] bps), against a verified structural cost floor C0 of 1.02 bps (SEC Section 31 on the sell leg plus FINRA TAF) and a break-even residual C* of -109.92 bps.
new_evidence.decision_implication: The executable-capture form of this mechanism does not clear its own entry friction on this sample by a wide margin; a kill is warranted only if the operator accepts that the reconstruction bias cannot account for a -109 bps gap.
new_evidence.gross_or_net: NET of verified mandatory charges C0; excludes unresolved C1
new_evidence.limitations: One session, one venue. The entry print comes from a book reconstructed from the retained window alone, which cannot see orders added before 15:49:50: the measured entry spread is therefore an upper bound and the measured capture a lower bound. The exchange published no near/far price band in any of the analysed 15:55 reads, so the preregistered reconstruction gate could not be evaluated as specified. 47.8% of the universe is removed by the frozen N/O/P direction rule.
new_evidence.methodology: Preregistered freeze (sha256 9baff3dd...e91393) then run: entry at the first eligible post-15:55 best ask (positive signal) or best bid (negative), exit at the Closing Cross; books reconstructed from the retained window; SEC Section 31 and FINRA TAF on the sell leg; symbol-clustered percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20260612.
new_evidence.sample: 1261 of 2465 universe-qualified Nasdaq-listed common stocks with a valid Closing Cross carrying a B/S signed imbalance at both frozen reads, one session

new_evidence.claim: The frozen mechanism metric - the side-signed Closing Cross displacement against the 15:55 Current Reference Price - is +6.52 bps pooled (95% CI [2.00, 11.00] bps) over the same 1261 symbols, i.e. the cross moves in the signal's direction but by roughly 1/17 of the entry friction the executable capture pays.
new_evidence.decision_implication: The displacement the mechanism predicts is real but an order of magnitude smaller than the spread it must cross at 15:55.
new_evidence.limitations: The reference price is a crossing-price construct, not the inside midpoint, so this is a displacement measure rather than an achievable return.
new_evidence.methodology: Preregistered secondary metric, same freeze and sample; raw displacement reported unsigned alongside (-4.77 bps pooled).
